    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:

    a, b, m, r0 = map(int, data[:4])

    seen = {}  # value -> index

        seq.append(r)
        r = (a * r + b) % m
    
    # Cycle starts at index seen[r], cycle length is len(seq) - seen[r]
    cycle_start = seen[r]
